name: Symkind AI Agent
author: davidgarcia1969

sections.description:
Symkind AI Agent adds an intelligent, conversational AI assistant to your WordPress website. Unlike generic chatbots that give shallow, scripted responses, Symkind agents are powered by a structured genome — up to 100,000 words of deep industry knowledge organized into 13+ layers, with subscription tiers that stack additional behavioral depth on top.

The result is an AI that doesn’t just answer questions — it understands your industry, reads your customers, represents your business with genuine expertise, and speaks every customer in their own language while staying unmistakably you.

What makes Symkind different:

  • 50,000+ word genomes — not a 200-word prompt. Deep, structured knowledge.
  • 42 industry-specific agents — architecture, insurance, real estate, plumbing, legal, dental, automotive, and more.
  • Speaks 50+ languages as you — Spanish, Mandarin, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Arabic, Tagalog, and more. Your personality preserved across every language. Patent-pending.
  • Identity that holds — your agent won’t break character or become a generic AI mid-conversation. Loyalty-locked to your business.
  • Four subscription tiers — Associate ($500), Senior ($1,200), Partner ($3,000), Super Agent ($10,000). Each tier stacks additional genome depth.
  • Lead generation built in — naturally guides visitors toward booking, calling, or connecting. Delivers a strategic lead brief to your inbox after each qualified conversation.
  • Returning customer memory (Senior tier and above) — remembers every customer across sessions.
  • Works on any WordPress site — one-click install, floating chat widget, customizable colors.
  • Patent-pending architecture — 11 U.S. provisional patents filed covering genome composition, voice preservation, identity-preserving multilingual, boardroom orchestration, tiered historical accumulation, and more.

Free tier included:
Install the plugin and get a general AI assistant with 100 messages/month at no cost. Upgrade to a genome-powered agent for deep industry knowledge.

See the difference:
Visit symkind.ai/the-difference.html to see the eight structural reasons a Symkind agent does what no generic AI can.

External Services

This plugin connects to Symkind’s hosted AI service at symkind.ai to provide its core functionality.

AI Response API (symkind.ai)
What it does: Generates AI responses for visitor conversations on your WordPress site.
What is sent: The visitor’s message, the conversation history for that session, your API key, and your selected agent configuration.
When it is sent: On every message a visitor sends to the chat widget.
This service is provided by Symkind LLC.
– Terms of Service: https://symkind.ai/terms-of-service.html
– Privacy Policy: https://symkind.ai/privacy-policy.html

Lead Capture Service (symkind.ai/save-lead.php)
What it does: When the AI agent identifies a qualified lead during a conversation, it sends a summary to Symkind’s server, which forwards it to your configured notification email.
What is sent: A summary of the conversation and any contact information the visitor voluntarily shared (such as name, phone, email, or service interest).
When it is sent: Only when a lead is detected in a conversation. No data is sent for ordinary informational conversations.
This service is provided by Symkind LLC.
– Terms of Service: https://symkind.ai/terms-of-service.html
– Privacy Policy: https://symkind.ai/privacy-policy.html

Site owners are responsible for disclosing the use of this service to their visitors in accordance with applicable privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the symkind-ai-agent folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Symkind AI to configure your agent
  4. Choose your industry, pick your subscription tier, set your business name, and customize colors
  5. The chat widget appears automatically on your site
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

The free tier works without an API key (100 messages/month). For genome-powered agents with higher limits, get an API key at symkind.ai.

What industries are supported?

42 industries including architecture, insurance, real estate, home improvement, automotive, legal, dental, health, travel, wedding, education, and more.

Does it really speak 50+ languages?

Yes. Your agent detects the customer’s language per turn and responds in that language — while preserving your business’s voice, opinions, and specific recommendations. Spanish-you is still you. Patent-pending technology.

What’s the difference between the tiers?

Associate ($500/mo) gives you the 50,000-word genome, lead intelligence briefs, and loyalty-lock to your business. Senior ($1,200/mo) adds returning-customer memory across sessions. Partner ($3,000/mo) adds cross-agent intelligence and a monthly custom layer. Super Agent ($10,000/mo) adds 13 deep behavioral layers — Master Sales Craft, Conflict De-escalation, Wit, Emotional Intelligence, Negotiation Psychology, and more.

Can I customize the look?

Yes. Change the widget color, position (left or right), business name, and greeting from the settings page.

Can I remove the Symkind branding?

Paid plans (Associate tier and above) can remove the “Powered by Symkind” branding.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Symkind does not store personal visitor data beyond what your tier requires for memory features. Conversations at Associate tier are processed in real-time and not retained. Senior tier and above retain compressed memory records of returning customers with your consent and the customer’s.

  • Floating chat widget with customizable colors
  • Free tier with 100 messages/month
